title: Scrub secrets before sharing
role: Developers and support engineers who paste logs, curl commands and API responses into tickets, chat or an AI assistant
saves: Hunting by hand for the bearer token, cookie or API key hidden in a 200-line paste, and the leak when one is missed
summary: Type =scrub and paste a log, curl command, HTTP exchange, JSON response or .env. Copy it back with tokens, keys, passwords, cookies and emails masked, and everything else untouched.

tests.name: curl command with a bearer token and an api key in the query
JSON error response keeps the diagnosis, loses the secrets
env file with cloud and SaaS keys
raw HTTP exchange with cookies
tests.input:
GET /v1/me HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Cookie: session=7f3a9c; csrftoken=b81e

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Set-Cookie: session=91be44; HttpOnly; Secure
tests.expect:
GET /v1/me HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Cookie: [REDACTED]

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Set-Cookie: [REDACTED]

tests.name: private key block in a config paste
tests.input:
tls:
  key: |
-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
MIIEpAIBAAKCAQEAexample
QWERTYexample
-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
  port: 8443

tests.name: text with no secrets comes back unchanged
